--- is_distinct_from_logical.sql
NOT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND 2 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2 OR FALSE

--- AST
&ast.BinaryExpr{
  Op:   "OR",
  Left: &ast.BinaryExpr{
    Op:   "AND",
    Left: &ast.UnaryExpr{
      Op:   "NOT",
      Expr: &ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
        Left: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 4,
          ValueEnd: 5,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
        Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 23,
          ValueEnd: 24,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
      },
    },
    Right: &ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
      Not:  true,
      Left: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 29,
        ValueEnd: 30,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "2",
      },
      Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 52,
        ValueEnd: 53,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "2",
      },
    },
  },
  Right: &ast.BoolLiteral{
    ValuePos: 57,
  },
}

--- SQL
NOT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND 2 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2 OR FALSE
